lines.text: Paul says Christ set believers free, and those who seek justification by the law have been severed from Christ.
Through the Spirit, believers eagerly await righteousness by faith, and what matters is faith expressing itself through love.
Paul says the Galatians were running well, and a little salt works through the whole batch of dough.
The one troubling the Galatians will bear the judgment, and preaching circumcision would abolish the offense of the cross.
The entire law is fulfilled in "Honor your father," and biting and devouring one another risks being consumed.
